decisions.reason: The product exceeded aspirations by winning a gold medal from the German Bread Institute in both 2023 and 2024, giving no reason to search for alternatives.
It remains presented on its own page with no evidence of a shortfall, indicating satisfactory results that make the firm unlikely to drop it.
The product continues to be listed without negative signals, and with industry growth providing slack, the firm is likely to carry this close-to-established item.
